$comment: Entry schema for contributes.snippets (declarative and process plugins). Each path names a strict-JSON VS Code snippet file ({"<name>": {"prefix": string|string[], "body": string|string[], "description"?: string|string[]}}) inside the package's snippets/ or assets/ directory. The desktop host validates the file structure and bounds; the frontend validates snippet body syntax and the Monaco language.
description: Editor snippet files per Monaco language (VS Code snippet format, strict JSON).

language.description: Monaco language id, for example typescript, sql or python.

path.description: Package-relative path of the snippet file, for example snippets/typescript.json.
